prompts.title: The Lavender Princess
prompts.prompt:
Create a photorealistic 4:5 vertical birthday portrait of the uploaded woman seated gracefully at a decorated birthday table, recreating this luxurious lavender celebration scene.

Subject Consistency & Age Preservation
Use the uploaded woman as the main subject reference and keep her recognizable overall likeness consistent. Preserve her natural facial structure, face shape, skin tone, eye shape, eyebrows, nose, lips, and overall appearance so she clearly looks like the same woman. Also preserve her natural age and age-appropriate facial maturity from the uploaded image. Do not make her look noticeably younger or older. Avoid identity drift, facial distortion, beauty-filter effects, overly artificial facial changes, or generic doll-like beauty.

Subject & Pose
Show the woman from the waist up, sitting slightly angled toward the camera with a warm, natural smile. Her posture is elegant and relaxed, with both arms resting softly near the table. She should look directly at the camera with a cheerful, graceful birthday expression.

Outfit & Styling
Dress her in a glittering lavender-purple elegant off-shoulder birthday gown with a fitted bodice and subtle sparkling fabric texture. Add a delicate silver crystal tiara on her head. Her hair should be styled in soft, voluminous waves flowing over one shoulder, with refined party-ready makeup and a polished, feminine look.

Birthday Table Setup
In front of her, place a round white birthday cake on a lavender tablecloth. The cake should be elegant and minimal, decorated with soft white frosting drapes and small purple rose accents. On top of the cake, add elegant birthday candles with warm flames. Keep the cake clearly visible in the foreground.

Lavender, lilac, and deep purple balloons
Soft floral arrangements of pink, purple, and cream roses
Warm glowing candles in the background
A white vintage chair partially visible behind her
Gentle gold and purple confetti falling through the air

Lighting & Mood
Use soft warm cinematic lighting with a cozy candlelit glow, flattering highlights on the face, and subtle sparkle on the gown and tiara. The scene should feel luxurious, festive, feminine, and emotionally warm. Keep the background softly blurred with a premium shallow depth of field.

Visual Quality
